welcome.title: Welcome to iDeploy
welcome.body: This is where your applications go from your computer to the internet. In one minute, here is where everything lives.

addNew.title: Everything starts with “Add New”
addNew.body: “New Application” puts your code, a Docker image or a ready-made app online. The same menu creates a workspace or connects a server.

projects.title: Your applications
projects.body: Each one shows here with its live status and address. Click a card to manage it: redeploy, read its logs, set its domain.

deploy.title: Deploy
deploy.body: A workspace groups the parts of one application — a site, an API, a database — so they run together. Templates install WordPress, n8n or Plausible in one click.

resources.title: Your resources
resources.body: Servers, applications, databases, services: everything running for you, sorted by type. No server yet? Connect your own or create one in the cloud from “Servers”.

usage.title: What your plan allows
usage.body: The applications and servers in use, against your plan’s limit. “Upgrade” gives you more room when you need it.

configuration.title: Account settings
configuration.body: Settings, shared variables, notifications, SSH keys, access tokens and team: these apply to all your applications.

menu.title: Your account
menu.body: Profile, language, theme — and “Replay the tour”, to take this tour again whenever you like.

done.title: You are ready
done.body: Next step: “Add New”, then “New Application”. A short tour also waits on each application’s page.

sources.title: Where does your application come from?
sources.body: Three paths: your code (GitHub, GitLab or a Git URL), a ready-made app, or a published Docker image. Pick one.

panel.title: Fill in, then go live
panel.body: This panel follows your choice. Under “My code”, if your project has several parts (website, API, database), a guide puts them online and connects them for you.

done.title: Your turn
done.body: No server yet? iDeploy will offer to connect or create one, then bring you back here to finish.

header.title: Your application
header.body: Its name, live status and public address. “Redeploy” publishes the latest version; the “…” button restarts or stops it.

tabs.title: Everything is set here
tabs.body: Deployments and their logs, variables, storage, scheduled tasks, pipeline, security, resource use and settings (repository, domain): one tab per topic.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.body: What is left to set up. Each line takes you where it is done, and the list goes away once everything is.

back.title: The left bar follows the application
back.body: While you are here, it shows this application only. This arrow takes you back to the dashboard and your whole account.

done.title: That’s it
done.body: You can replay this tour anytime from your avatar menu.
